content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Durham

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the experience and educational prerequisites. Document your project hours and educational background before applying—this foundation is essential for approval.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Durham-focused cohorts meet online with experienced instructors who teach the PMBOK® Guide framework and real-world application. Finish all 35 required contact hours before submitting your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal education, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application with proof of your contact hours and work experience. Pay the applicable PMI examination fee when you apply. PMI reviews applications to confirm you meet all credential requirements.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guides to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the computer-based exam at an authorized testing center—Durham has several locations within easy reach.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, maintain your PMP by earning professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year cycle. Attend training, contribute to the profession, and stay current with project-management practice. Renew your credential on schedule to keep it active and recognized by employers across North Carolina and beyond.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
